Card Q&A.a: Yes, that's correct. In addition to Digimon from the hand or battle area, you may also place cards from the trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
Card Q&A.q: Does "When you would play this card, you can also place cards from your trash in digivolution cards for a DigiXros" mean that you can place cards from your hand, batle area and trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If there are 2 or more cards that can be targeted in your trash, you must either play 2 of them or none.
Card Q&A.q: If this card is played by DigiXrosing, if there's 2 or more purple level 4 or lower Digimon cards or level 4 or lower Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I play only 1 instead?

Effect: Cards in your trash can also be placed for this Digimon's DigiXros.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is purple or has the [Xros Heart] trait from your trash without paying the cost. If DigiXrosing, add 1 to the number this effect plays.
[All Turns] All of your Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait or ＜Retaliation＞ gain ＜Rush＞ and ＜Blocker＞.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -3: 1 Digimon card w/[Xros Heart] trait
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from the hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
